title: Supplier Invoice Automation
technologies: Python | PySide6 | SQLite | OpenCV | PyMuPDF | Watchdog
description: Windows desktop app that files Portuguese supplier invoices. PDFs can be dropped in, browsed, or picked up from a watched folder. PyMuPDF renders each page and OpenCV reads the tax QR. The parser checks supplier, client, date, VAT, and total, then SQLite records the result and the PDF is stored by supplier, year, and month. Duplicates and unknown suppliers are logged instead of filed again. A background worker keeps the PySide6 window responsive while a batch is processing.
